coverageNote: All 45 current Markdown source files completed the 3a implementer simulation, 3b rubric scoring, and 3c devil's-advocate pass across 8 domain units. Scope-limited scoring assessed Dimensions 3, 7, and 8 for each unit (24 applicable checkpoints); Dimensions 1, 2, 4, 5, and 6 depend on sources outside the user-specified directory and were not inferred. Scoped structural checks found every unit has an index and CX file, every unit index has a Role Matrix, and all 29 feature files have Role Lens and Edge Cases sections.

findings.claim: Root-unit open decisions are stage-routed but omit the required resolution deadline and the decision blocked; the jam freshness threshold is also left as an unowned pending operational value.

evidence.excerpt: Q-05 asks how a musician with no credits gets discovered, then supplies only User and /create-prd.
The Unconfirmed state says the exact freshness window is pending /write-be-spec.

findings.forcedInvention: Choose the jam freshness threshold and its lifecycle/sorting contract, plus when the unresolved newcomer-discovery decision must be settled.
findings.failureScenario: Different clients classify the same jam as confirmed or stale, sending users to stopped events while the no-credit discovery path remains arbitrarily gated.

findings.claim: Connection and endorsement lifecycle decisions lack required deadlines and explicit blocked decisions; severance behavior remains pending at the cross-cut.

evidence.excerpt: Q-05 asks for the unanswered connection-request expiry horizon and supplies User plus /write-be-spec, with no deadline or blocked decision.
The exact endorsement retraction rule after a connection severance is pending deepening.

findings.forcedInvention: Choose the request expiry/cooldown and whether an invalidated relationship retracts, hides, or preserves its endorsements.
findings.failureScenario: Concurrent severance and endorsement writes produce inconsistent public credentials or a pending queue that either nags targets indefinitely or discards valid requests.

findings.claim: The feed-delivery decision is assigned to a workflow rather than an owner and has neither a deadline nor an explicit blocked decision; the resulting control-invalidation behavior is still pending.

evidence.excerpt: Q-04 asks fan-out on write or read but names /create-prd as Owner and /create-prd-architecture as Deferred To.
Changing a control must rebuild a precomputed feed or accept staleness, marked pending.

findings.forcedInvention: Choose fan-out timing, control-change invalidation, and permitted staleness semantics.
findings.failureScenario: A muted source continues to reach a reader after the control changes, or implementations incur incompatible write amplification and cache behavior.

findings.claim: Open-collaboration response handling is unresolved without a complete owner/deadline/blocked-decision record, despite directly determining whether the feature becomes a shortlist workflow.

evidence.excerpt: Response handling, including responder evaluation and a shortlist, is pending Q-01/Q-03 /create-prd-architecture.
A call with 200 responses has no triage behavior and says a shortlist would make it domain 04.

findings.forcedInvention: Choose the response/selection lifecycle, high-volume triage behavior, and the ownership boundary with Opportunities & Casting.
findings.failureScenario: One implementation silently closes late responses while another creates an assessment shortlist, producing contradictory contracts and turning a peer call into an ungoverned hiring flow.

findings.claim: Reachability failure semantics are an unresolved safety decision with no deadline or decision-blocked field; the spec leaves the system to choose whether a traversal error opens or closes an inbound wall.

evidence.excerpt: The Error state asks Fail open or closed? and marks the choice unresolved.
Q-04 supplies only Agent and /create-prd-architecture for the fail-open/fail-closed decision.

findings.forcedInvention: Choose the authorization result on graph traversal failure and the associated retry/audit behavior.
findings.failureScenario: Fail-open exposes a flood-protected Producer during degradation; fail-closed silently loses legitimate connection, call, and message attempts.

findings.claim: Privacy-critical reconciliation and subject-scope decisions are pending without the required owner/deadline/blocked-decision record.

evidence.excerpt: The reconciliation trigger and matching confidence model are pending deepening.
Whether a user may keep private notes about a Fan is pending and only described as likely prohibited.

findings.forcedInvention: Choose the reconciliation trigger/candidate-confidence contract and whether Fan subjects are eligible for private note records.
findings.failureScenario: A wrong or automatic reconciliation attaches defamation-adjacent notes to an innocent account, or private files are created for a class of users without an approved safety and legal basis.

findings.claim: Steward authority and abandonment recovery are open authority decisions without the required owner/deadline/blocked-decision record.

evidence.excerpt: The steward's actual powers are marked pending as the feature's central question.
The Lapsed state says an inactive steward reverts to unclaimed, marked pending.

findings.forcedInvention: Choose the steward power set, appointment/revocation authority, and lapse/rotation rule.
findings.failureScenario: A local competitor gains undefined moderation powers or an abandoned steward role remains authoritative with no valid recovery transition.

findings.claim: The contest's stalled-judge path lacks the required deadline, owner, and blocked-decision record, even though it prevents a verdict and payout.

evidence.excerpt: A judge who does not judge stalls the contest indefinitely and needs a deadline and fallback.
The Stalled state says Fallback needed — pending.

findings.forcedInvention: Choose the judging deadline, replacement/void/refund fallback, and the resulting contest-state transition.
findings.failureScenario: A contest remains indefinitely pending after entrants submit work and escrowed prizes cannot be awarded or released.
